description: List all Ring devices grouped by category (doorbots, stickup_cams, chimes).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the devices document keyed by category; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single device by its numeric id.

device_id.description: Numeric id of the device to retrieve.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type, device_type (category) and the device object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get health information (firmware, battery, wifi signal, alerts) for a device.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type and device_health details; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Update mutable settings on a device (motion, detection, led, light schedule).

device_id.description: Numeric id of the device to update.

motion_detection_enabled.description: Optional flag to enable/disable motion detection.

people_detection_enabled.description: Optional flag to enable/disable people detection.

package_detection_enabled.description: Optional flag to enable/disable package detection.

light_schedule_enabled.description: Optional flag to enable/disable the light schedule.

light_on_duration_seconds.description: Optional duration in seconds the light stays on.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type, device_type and the updated device object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get the location details for the given location id.

location_id.description: Id of the location to retrieve.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type and the location object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List all devices belonging to the given location.

location_id.description: Id of the location whose devices to list.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the devices document; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get the current security mode for the given location.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type, mode and location_id; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Set the security mode for a location (home, away, or disarmed).

mode.description: New mode; must be one of home, away, disarmed.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type, mode and location_id; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List currently active dings (in-progress events) across devices.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the list of active dings; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List event history for a device with optional filtering and pagination.

device_id.description: Numeric id of the device whose events to list.

kind.description: Optional event kind to filter by.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 20).

offset.description: Number of events to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type, count, total, offset, limit and the results list; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single event by its numeric id.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type and the event object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get the recording url for an event whose recording is ready.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type, event_id and recording_url; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List ready recordings for a device with optional date filtering.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type, count and the results list of recordings; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List shared users for the given location.

location_id.description: Id of the location whose shared users to list.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type, count and the results list of shared users; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single shared user by user id within a location.

user_id.description: Numeric id of the shared user.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type and the shared_user object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get the settings for a chime device.

device_id.description: Numeric id of the chime device.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type and the chime settings; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Link a chime to a doorbell so it plays for that doorbell's events.

device_id.description: Numeric id of the chime device.

doorbell_id.description: Numeric id of the doorbell to link.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type and the updated chime settings; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Unlink a chime from a doorbell.

device_id.description: Numeric id of the chime device.

doorbell_id.description: Numeric id of the doorbell to unlink.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type and the updated chime settings; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List the motion detection zones configured for a device.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type, count and the results list of motion zones; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List notification preferences across all devices.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type, count and the results list of notification preferences; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get the notification preferences for a device and channel.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type and the notification_pref object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Update notification preferences (motion, ding, person, package alerts) for a device.

motion_alerts.description: Optional flag to enable/disable motion alerts.

ding_alerts.description: Optional flag to enable/disable ding alerts.

person_alerts.description: Optional flag to enable/disable person alerts.

package_alerts.description: Optional flag to enable/disable package alerts.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type and the updated notification_pref object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Activate the siren on a device that has one, for a given duration.

duration_seconds.description: Duration in seconds the siren stays on (default 30).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type, device_id and siren_status; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Deactivate the siren on a device that has one.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type, device_id and siren_status; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Turn a device's floodlight on or off.

on.description: Whether the floodlight should be on (true) or off (false).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains type, device_id and floodlight_status; on failure, output contains an error message.
